content_of_post_to_answer: How do you stay consistent with your healthy habits?
answer: Consistency becomes easier when you stop treating healthy habits as a test of discipline and start treating them as part of your environment. The people who last usually don't rely on feeling motivated; they reduce the number of decisions required to do the right thing. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile, if you're curious. A habit survives when it becomes the default, not when it remains a daily battle.
